In progress. Credentialed access obtained; study design under way.
:::

A clinical prediction study using MIMIC-IV, a de-identified critical care
database of intensive care admissions from a US teaching hospital.

What the project will involve:

- cohort definition and feature engineering from routinely collected ICU data
- interpretable models evaluated on discrimination, calibration and subgroup performance
- reporting to TRIPOD+AI and held up to NHS RAP framework
- a repository that runs end to end on the open MIMIC-IV demo subset, so the pipeline can be executed without credentialed access

Thumbnail on project page reproduced with [authors'](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01899-x) permission under [CC](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
